description: Professional Barcode Generation UPCgen is a comprehensive online barcode generator designed for e-commerce sellers and developers. It provides a streamlined interface to create valid UPC, EAN-13, ISBN, ITF-14, Code 128, FNSKU, and Data Matrix barcodes without requiring a signup. The platform ensures all generated codes are platform-approved for major marketplaces. Developer-First API Integration Beyond manual generation, UPCgen offers a robust REST API for programmatic barcode creation. Develope
